simulate_error.label: Inject Simulated Error
simulate_error.description: Make the next firmware step on a module return a chosen error (writes <instrument>_Simulator.cfg). Simulation mode only.

module.label: Module
module.help: Pick a module, or type one (1mL, 5mL, X1, MPH96, MPH384, iSWAP/IPG, Autoload/IDL, MagPip).

step.label: Firmware Step
step.help: Pick a step for the module, or type words (fuzzy-matched).

error.label: Error Description
error.help: Pick an error for the module, or type words (fuzzy-matched), or "1.<desc>;2.<desc>" per channel.

channels.label: Channels
channels.help: Per-channel modules (1mL/5mL/X1/MagPip) only; leave blank to apply to all 8 channels

simulate_error_by_code.label: Inject Simulated Error (by code)
simulate_error_by_code.description: Write a raw firmware error code with no keyword matching.

teach_well.label: Teach Well
teach_well.description: Find a plate well's four walls and bottom, and compare with the labware definition. Pick up a needle first.

well.label: Well
well.help: Default: the first position. A well near the plate center is best.

search_depth.label: Search Depth (mm)
search_depth.help: How far into the well each wall probe goes.

teaching_eject_needle.label: Eject Teaching Needle
teaching_eject_needle.description: Return the teaching needle to its pickup position.

teaching_get_channel.label: Get Teaching Channel
teaching_get_channel.description: Return the 1 mL channel used for teaching.

teaching_get_labware_dimensions.label: Get Labware Dimensions
teaching_get_labware_dimensions.description: Labware center, bottom and height, and a well's center, bottom and depth.

teaching_is_needle_picked_up.label: Is Needle Picked Up?
teaching_is_needle_picked_up.description: Whether the teaching channel holds a teaching needle.

teaching_measure_wall.label: Measure Wall (XY)
teaching_measure_wall.description: Step toward one wall, probing Z, until the needle stalls on the wall top. Start inside the well at its entrance.

teaching_measure_z.label: Measure Z Height
teaching_measure_z.description: Search down until the needle stalls and return the stall height.

teaching_move_channel.label: Move Teaching Channel
teaching_move_channel.description: Move the teaching needle; omitted axes stay where they are.

teaching_pickup_needle.label: Pick Up Teaching Needle
teaching_pickup_needle.description: Pick up a teaching needle with the teaching channel.

teaching_set_channel.label: Set Teaching Channel
teaching_set_channel.description: Set the 1 mL channel used for teaching. Not allowed while a needle is held; reset on every connect.
